about.title: About Kyrgyzstan
about.subtitle: Discover the country of mountains, lakes, and hospitable people

geography.title: Geography
geography.content: Kyrgyzstan is a mountainous country in Central Asia, known for its majestic Tian Shan mountains and crystal clear Lake Issyk-Kul, the second largest mountain lake in the world.

culture.title: Culture
culture.content: Kyrgyz culture is rich in traditions, music, and crafts. Kyrgyz people are known for their hospitality and nomadic traditions.

tourism.title: Tourism
tourism.content: Kyrgyzstan offers diverse tourism opportunities: from beach vacations at Issyk-Kul to mountain hiking, horseback riding, and experiencing nomadic culture.
